longDescription: A nostalgic 90's-themed portfolio website where I showcase projects I've built throughout my career as a Front-End Developer. Inspired by the colorful, playful aesthetics that defined my childhood, this project is both a professional portfolio and a creative expression of the things that bring me joy. Built as a learning project to deepen my experience with Tailwind CSS and TypeScript, it combines modern web development practices with a retro internet vibe.
